hotspots.title: Trump-Meloni feud escalates
hotspots.blurb: Public spat between Donald Trump and Italian PM Giorgia Meloni intensifies over G7 photo claims, Iran policy, and NATO base access, with Meloni dismissing Trump's accusations as baseless and Trump doubling down on criticism.
hotspots.affect: This feud commands disproportionate attention due to its high-profile nature, moral charge over sovereignty and alliance loyalty, and polarized framing between U.S. and European right-wing narratives.
